name: Pepys
summary: Audio and video transcription with timestamps in 99 languages, summaries and exports; pay per hour of audio with no subscription.
best_for: researchers, journalists, podcasters and students who transcribe audio or video in bursts and want to pay per hour, with no monthly subscription
skip_if: you need live meeting capture with a bot in the call, you transcribe every day and prefer a flat monthly plan, or you want a tool we have tested on real recordings
honest_knock: Speaker labels use three times the credits. The team plan has no visible price. The page shows euros but bills in USD, and all sales are final. Pepys Dictate, the Mac dictation app, is a separate product.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-13 on pepys.co/pricing, amounts shown in euros and billed in USD) Pepys has a free account and pay-as-you-go credits. The free account gives 60 minutes once, with no card, files up to 1 GB, transcription in 99 languages with timestamps, AI summary, chapters and chat, translation, exports to TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT, VTT and JSON, and API access metered on your free minutes. Paid credits cost €1.1 an hour on purchases under €17.6, €0.88 an hour from €17.6 and €0.75 an hour from €74.8. The smallest pack shown is 10 hours for €11 and the next 20 hours for €17.6. Any purchase unlocks files up to 5 GB and 10 hours, unlimited Google Drive, OneDrive and Zoom imports, batch upload of up to 100 files, speaker labels at 3 credits per minute, word-level timestamp exports and removal of the Pepys mark. The page says credits never expire, personal use has no subscription and all sales are final. Teams can add a flat monthly plan, but the page shows no price for it. We did not buy credits, so we do not know the tax added or how the team plan is priced.

schema_offer.description: 10-hour pack, 10 hours cost €11; 20 hours cost €17.6; the hourly rate is €1.1 under €17.6, €0.88 from €17.6 and €0.75 from €74.8; the page says billed in USD; speaker labels use 3 credits per minute. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-13.
